image_description: A close-up studio shot of a green cucumber that has been partially sliced. The main body of the cucumber is on the left, showing its dark green, slightly bumpy skin. To the right, three circular slices are arranged in an overlapping row, revealing the pale green/white flesh and the central seed cavity with small seeds. The background is pure white.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture on the green skin appears slightly overly smooth and plastic-like in certain areas, lacking the fine micro-details of real vegetable skin, though not structurally incorrect.
Slight softness/blur on the furthest slice could be depth-of-field simulation or minor generation artifact; hard to distinguish from intentional photographic blur.
